raw_segments.text: To me, bless you, child, what an idea. To me, I am only the housekeeper, the manager.
To be sure, I am distantly related to the Rochester's by the mother's side, or at
least my husband was. He was a clergyman, incumbent of hay, that little village yonder
on the hill, and that church near the gates was his.
The present Mr. Rochester's mother was a Fairfax, and second cousin to my husband,
but I never presume on the connection. In fact, it is nothing to me. I consider myself
